assumptions: repository fixture is used only to test deterministic adapter and observation behavior
proposal.objective: Validate the historical snapshot adapter and execute one repository-fixture, non-contact shadow observation without treating fixture output as actual business evidence.

rollback_plan.procedure: discard generated observation records, preserve shadow_only gates, and open an incident if any boundary was crossed
rollback_plan.trigger: schema failure, hash mismatch, council veto, or any external side effect

success_criteria: all five council records are independently bound to one proposal hash
no customer contact, publication, money movement, deployment, registry mutation, or agent promotion occurs
unknowns: actual historical revenue data is not present in the repository
